pages.text: $(bold)Drops$(): 1-4x $(item)Echo Dust$() with Looting adding 0-3; rare pools use 1.12 music records as ancient-city loot substitutes.$(br)

This ritual summons a dedicated 1.12 $(#ad03fc)Possessed Warden$() from a local squid sacrifice and a bound $(#ad03fc)Djinni$(). It uses echo dust, redstone, and obsidian in place of Sculk materials. The entity keeps the upstream size and core attributes, but its Brain, $()
vibration sensing, darkness, digging, and true sonic boom are represented by the documented 1.12 pulse and blindness compatibility behavior.$(br)
